page.layout: One page of text, full width: running head at top, page number at top left; a paragraph of italic and roman text; the word FINIS in spaced capitals centred; a woodcut ornament (fleuron) below; a catchword-like signature "IN-" at lower right.

main_text.p: Ministri, ex Hebraeorum monumentis fide dignis ostendamus. Id quod proxima occasione, si Deus vitam viresque concesserit, in Investigatione nostra conabimur praestare.
main_text.head: FINIS.

page.notes: The ornament is a woodcut fleuron between FINIS and the lower right mark; not transcribed as text. The "IN-" at lower right is a catchword. The printed page number is 296; the running head is in spaced capitals. Original spelling "Hebrꝛorum" reads Hebraeorum as printed ("Hebræorum" in the scan, æ ligature). Ligature in "praestare" rendered as printed. Some spots of scan damage are not text.
